gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-familjen-grotesk: Lively and a bit unfinished, Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls open on one side beneath Bruno Ace, whose line never changes width. Moderate lowercase height against a tall one is what sets them apart.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-quicksand: Ruler-straight meets blown glass: Bruno Ace keeps a constant-width line, while Quicksand lifts its bowls tall and round. And Quicksand's terminals stop well short of the stem, so the heading's steady bars have a softer neighbor.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-amarna: Amarna draws contrast-free strokes from stem to terminal, keeping every small counter unclogged beneath the display heading. Bruno Ace supplies the ruler-drawn flourish up top while Amarna keeps the lines below clean and legible.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-andika: Andika gives its tails and terminals full stem-like heft, and its s shapes turn wide and easy. Bruno Ace does best at lingering, expressive display lines; Andika does best at modern, professional text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-assistant: Assistant leaves its letter mouths open, and this plain sans sits beneath Bruno Ace's thread of ink with no swelling. Paragraphs should move along smoothly, with nothing snagging the eye.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cambay: Cambay lets its rounds gap like a cracked bangle, a modern foil for Bruno Ace's stroke widths that never budge. Lines of text flow lightly, with each round leaving a small opening.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cantarell: Cantarell reads approachable, its c shapes pulled well apart at the tips. Nudge its size up and the arches of r, n and m, matching their stems, stand up to Bruno Ace.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans-sc: Encode Sans SC curls its terminals just slightly and leaves a wide gap, giving Bruno Ace a sober partner. And the reading feels relaxed and unhurried, a smooth run of text beneath that uniform headline.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans-semi-exp: Bruno Ace holds its thickness in every direction, while Encode Sans Semi Expanded rounds its letters and leaves them open. One is built to draw attention, the other to carry text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 stays clean, its curves full of daylight, while Bruno Ace draws a rope-thin outline throughout. Exo 2 then reads easily line after line, never crowding its own letters.
